messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the Canadian federal holidays in 2023 that create “long weekends” (i.e., a holiday falling on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day break):

| Date | Holiday | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| **January 2** | New Year’s Day (observed) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday Jan 1, so the holiday was observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| **February 20** | Family Day (Ontario & some other provinces) | Family Day is celebrated on the third Monday of February in Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, and New Brunswick. |
| **April 7** | Good Friday | Good Friday is always on the Friday before Easter Sunday. |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Celebrated on the last Monday before May 25. |
| **July 3** | Canada Day (observed) | Canada Day fell on Saturday Jul 1, so the holiday was observed on Monday Jul 3. |
| **September 4** | Labour Day | Labour Day is celebrated on the first Monday in September. |
| **October 10** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is celebrated on the second Monday in October. |
| **December 25** | Christmas Day | Christmas Day is always on December 25; in 2023 it fell on a Monday. |

These dates give you a natural three‑day weekend (or longer if you take adjacent days off). If you’re building a holiday‑planning app, you can hard‑code these dates or pull them from a reliable calendar API such as Calendarific, Timezonedb, or the official Government of Canada public holiday listings.
